reference.title: Subscription Status Types
reference.shortdesc: A list of the subscription status types that can appear on the Subscription page and which actions are available for each status.

section.title: Available Statuses
section.p: The subscription can be in one of several statuses. Each status has its own visual indicator and available actions.

dlentry.dd:
Indicates that the organization is using a trial subscription. This status shows:
A yellow or orange status chip with a warning icon.
The trial expiration date.
A Buy subscription button to move to a paid plan.

Indicates that the trial period has ended. This status shows:
A red status chip that shows the trial has expired.
The expiration date.
A Buy subscription button to purchase a paid plan.
A Restart trial button, if available, to extend the trial period.

Indicates an active paid subscription. This status shows:
A green status chip that shows the subscription is active.
The renewal date.
A Manage subscription button to open Verifone account management.
A Renew plan button, if auto-renewal is disabled.
A Stop Auto-renewal button, if auto-renewal is enabled.
An Upgrade plan button to increase the number of available seats.
